Name: Simple Skateboard Retextures
Author: boringvlln
Description:
This a simple pastel recolor for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13096]Skateboard[/url] by aedenthorn.

Contains 26 options, and as soon as you first launch the game with this mod, a [b]config[/b] file will be created.

While technically it supports Generic Config Menu, I have encountered a bit of a issue: not all options can be displayed in the drop menu at the same time. Therefore manual editing of the config is probably preferable at this time.

The name of the option = the name of the corresponding texture in the [CP] Simple Skateboard Retextures/assets (without the format, of course).

So If you want your skateboard to be bright pink, you need to open config.json and set:
[quote]"Board Recolor": "board_pink_bright"[/quote]
Don't forget to save the file afterwards. If you worry you might have messed up, you can always delete it, and it will regenerate on next game launch.
